packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript below 7 until typescript-eslint supports it: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940
Hold ESLint below 10 until eslint-plugin-react supports it: https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react/issues/4018
Hold the changelog preset below 10 until release-notes-generator ships conventional-changelog-writer 9: https://github.com/semantic-release/release-notes-generator/issues/1027
Hold semantic-release below 26 until its plugins leave prerelease: 26 loads beta versions of commit-analyzer, release-notes-generator, and npm.
